        """Start the comment download in a separate thread."""
        # Validate input
        video_url = self.video_url_var.get().strip()
        if not video_url:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", "Please enter a YouTube video URL")
            return
            
        # Start download in separate thread to prevent UI blocking
        self.cancel_button.config(state=tk.NORMAL)
        self.download_thread = threading.Thread(target=self.download_comments, args=(video_url,))
        self.download_thread.daemon = True
        self.download_thread.start()
        
    def download_comments(self, video_url):
        """Download comments from YouTube video."""
        try:
            self.status_var.set("Initializing downloader...")
            self.root.update()
            
            # Create downloader instance
            downloader = YouTubeCommentDownloader(
                language=self.language_var.get(),
                sort=int(self.sort_var.get())
            )
            
            # Get max comments
            try:
                max_comments = int(self.max_comments_var.get())
            except ValueError:
                max_comments = 100
                
            # Download comments
            self.status_var.set("Downloading comments...")
            self.root.update()
            
            # Clear previous results
            self.comments_list = []
            self.tree.delete(*self.tree.get_children())
            
            # Download comments
            comments = list(downloader.get_comments(video_url, max_comments))
            
            # Update UI with results
            self.root.after(0, self.update_results, comments)
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.root.after(0, lambda: messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Download failed: {str(e)}"))
        finally:
            self.root.after(0, lambda: self.cancel_button.config(state=tk.DISABLED))
            self.status_var.set("Download completed")
    
    def update_results(self, comments):
        """Update the results treeview with downloaded comments."""
        self.comments_list = comments
        
        # Clear existing items
        for item in self.tree.get_children():
            self.tree.delete(item)
            
        # Add new items
        for comment in comments:
            try:
                # Format comment data for display
                author = getattr(comment, 'author', 'Unknown')
                text = getattr(comment, 'text', '').replace('\n', ' ')
                time = getattr(comment, 'time', 'Unknown')
                like_count = getattr(comment, 'like_count', 0)
                
                # Insert into treeview
                self.tree.insert('', tk.END, values=(author, text[:100] + "..." if len(text) > 100 else text, time, like_count))
                
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Error processing comment: {e}")
                continue
                
        self.status_var.set(f"Downloaded {len(comments)} comments")
    
    def cancel_download(self):
        """Cancel the current download."""
        self.status_var.set("Download cancelled")
        self.cancel_button.config(state=tk.DISABLED)
        
    def clear_results(self):
        """Clear all downloaded results."""
        self.tree.delete(*self.tree.get_children())
        self.comments_list = []
        self.status_var.set("Results cleared")

    """Main function to run the GUI application."""
    try:

        sys.exit(1)

    main()

                text = getattr(comment, 'text', '').replace('\n', ' ')
                time = getattr(comment, 'time', 'Unknown')
                like_count = getattr(comment, 'like_count', 0)
                
                # Insert into treeview
                self.tree.insert('', tk.END, values=(author, text[:100] + "..." if len(text) > 100 else text, time, like_count))
                
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Error processing comment: {e}")
                continue
                
        self.status_var.set(f"Downloaded {len(comments)} comments")
    
    def cancel_download(self):
        """Cancel the current download."""
        self.status_var.set("Download cancelled")
        self.cancel_button.config(state=tk.DISABLED)
        
    def clear_results(self):
        """Clear all downloaded results."""
        self.tree.delete(*self.tree.get_children())
        self.comments_list = []
        self.status_var.set("Results cleared")


def main():
    """Main function to run the GUI application."""
    try:
        root = tk.Tk()
        app = YouTubeCommentDownloaderGUI(root)
        root.mainloop()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error starting GUI: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
